simple.meaning: קוּם (qûwm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-) rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 36 times in Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 5:2. The surrounding contexts include family line, kingship, priesthood, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קוּם (H6966) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קוּם (qûwm) / H6966 is traced through Ezra 5:2, Ezra 6:18, Daniel 2:21, Daniel 2:31 with source-language evidence and verse context.
